### 📚 ALGEBRA 2 — CH6 FINISH / CH7 OPEN

*(Assumed position — confirm with Fatima.)*

**Chapter 6 — Exponential & Logarithmic Functions:**
- **6.1–6.2:** Exponential growth/decay + graphing exponential functions
- **6.3:** Logarithms and logarithmic functions (log is the inverse of exponential — anchor this)
- **6.4:** Transformations of exponential & logarithmic functions
- **6.5:** Properties of logarithms
- **6.6–6.7:** Solving exponential & logarithmic equations + modeling

**Chapter 7 — Rational Functions** (open this weekend if Ch6 is solid):
- Asymptotes, holes, and graphing — visual/conceptual, rewards careful work.
